location.label: Location & Accessibility

messages.high: The farm has strong access to roads and markets, supporting better transportation and economic resilience.
messages.medium: Farm accessibility is reasonable, although transportation distance may create additional costs.
messages.low: Limited accessibility may increase transportation costs and reduce market flexibility.

recommendations: Consider local storage to reduce dependence on immediate market access.
Explore multiple selling channels to improve market resilience.

land.label: Land Quality

messages.high: The land has strong productive characteristics and good potential for long-term agricultural use.
messages.medium: The land is reasonably productive but some characteristics require continued management.
messages.low: Land limitations may reduce long-term productivity and require corrective management.

recommendations: Maintain soil fertility through balanced nutrient management.
Monitor changes in soil quality over time.

soil.label: Soil Health

messages.high: The farm demonstrates strong soil-health management that can support productivity over the long term.
messages.medium: Soil health is reasonable, but increasing organic matter and improving nutrient monitoring could strengthen resilience.
messages.low: Current soil-management practices may reduce long-term soil health and increase dependence on external inputs.

recommendations: Increase organic matter through compost, manure or suitable residue management.
Use fertilizer according to crop and soil requirements.

water.label: Water Sustainability

messages.high: The farm demonstrates strong water-security characteristics and/or efficient irrigation practices.
messages.medium: Water availability is adequate, but irrigation efficiency and conservation could be improved.
messages.low: The farm may face significant future water-security pressure.

recommendations: Select crops according to long-term water availability.

weather.label: Climate & Weather Resilience

messages.high: The farm has strong characteristics for adapting to future climate variability.
messages.medium: The farm has some climate resilience, but additional adaptation could reduce future risks.
messages.low: The farm is relatively vulnerable to future climate variability and requires stronger adaptation.

recommendations: Diversify crops to reduce climate-related risk.
Develop strategies for drought and heat periods.
Improve drainage where flood risk exists.

crop.label: Crop Resilience

messages.high: The cropping system has strong resilience because of crop diversity and/or rotation.
messages.medium: The cropping system has some resilience but could be diversified further.
messages.low: Dependence on a limited number of crops increases exposure to pest, climate and market risks.

recommendations: Increase crop diversity where economically suitable.
Avoid long-term dependence on a single crop.
Consider including legumes or other soil-supporting crops in rotation.

messages.high: The farm demonstrates relatively efficient and environmentally responsible pest management.
messages.medium: Chemical dependency is moderate and could be reduced through integrated pest management.
messages.low: High chemical dependency creates environmental and economic sustainability concerns.

soilConservation.label: Soil Conservation

messages.high: The farm uses practices that protect soil structure and retain useful organic material.
messages.medium: Some soil-conservation practices are present, but there is room for improvement.
messages.low: Current practices may increase soil degradation and reduce long-term resilience.

recommendations: Return organic material to the soil where appropriate.

energy.label: Energy Sustainability

messages.high: The farm has relatively strong renewable-energy use and energy resilience.
messages.low: High dependence on conventional energy creates future cost and sustainability risks.

recommendations: Consider renewable energy where economically practical.
Consider solar-powered agricultural systems where appropriate.

biodiversity.label: Biodiversity & Ecosystem Health

messages.high: The farm provides strong ecological support for biodiversity and beneficial organisms.
messages.medium: Some biodiversity-supporting features exist but can be expanded.
messages.low: The farm has limited ecological diversity and could benefit from habitat improvements.

recommendations: Maintain or increase tree and vegetation cover.
Reduce unnecessary disturbance of surrounding habitats.

futureRisks.title: Water Efficiency
futureRisks.message: The current irrigation method may create greater water losses. Improving irrigation efficiency could strengthen future water security.

futureRisks.title: Future Water Risk
futureRisks.message: Limited water availability may become a major constraint. Water conservation and crop-water planning should be prioritised.

futureRisks.title: Residue Burning
futureRisks.message: Residue burning removes potentially useful organic material from the farming system. Consider mulching, composting or productive reuse.

futureRisks.title: Crop Diversity
futureRisks.message: Dependence on a single crop can increase vulnerability to climate, pest, disease and market shocks.

futureRisks.title: Crop Rotation
futureRisks.message: Introducing crop rotation can improve soil health and reduce crop-specific pest and disease pressure.

futureRisks.title: Chemical Dependency
futureRisks.message: High pesticide use may increase environmental pressure and input costs. Integrated pest management could improve future sustainability.

futureRisks.title: Climate Vulnerability
futureRisks.message: High drought risk combined with limited adaptation may create significant future production risk.

futureRisks.title: Soil Health
futureRisks.message: Poor fertility combined with no organic nutrient inputs may reduce long-term soil productivity.

rating.label: Excellent
rating.description: Highly sustainable and strongly prepared for future environmental and resource pressures.

rating.label: Very Good
rating.description: The farm has a strong sustainability foundation with some opportunities for improvement.

rating.label: Good
rating.description: The farm is reasonably sustainable but several areas could be improved.

rating.label: Needs Improvement
rating.description: The farm has important sustainability risks that should be addressed.

rating.label: High Risk
rating.description: The current farming system has significant long-term sustainability weaknesses.
